packet.question: 是否支持把已注册的交接状态来源问题作为 N3 下一候选，而不原样重复这次状态掩码实验？

changes_if_approved.to: 优先考虑已有 RETAIN、COPY、SHADOW 问题及其具名技术依赖；不在本卡直接启动

packet.if_refused: 保留已完成结果和可复用通用比较器，由 Root 选择已接受议程内的其他明确问题；不修改任何方向生命周期。

evidence_for.quote: Both learned arms attain mean final STALE_LOAD return `0.98828125`.
evidence_for.why: 当前主比较已接近该环境上限，原样重复缺少新判别问题。

evidence_for.quote: The next object uses three-to-five independent seeds on a small predeclared first-valid-trigger panel and compares RETAIN, COPY, and SHADOW under the same checkpoints and future tapes.
evidence_for.why: 现有注册问题可以区分状态来源，避免把 N3 限制在记忆是否被清空。

evidence_against.quote: C03 reached its terminal technical rule when the remote sparse checkout omitted the frozen test (`0` collected); no cost or science ran, the unaccepted code was quarantined, and the direction is queued behind that named checkout dependency.
evidence_against.why: 此对象尚有自己的技术依赖，不能直接使用未接受实现或把技术缺失解释成结果。

evidence_against.quote: Three seeds, one scalar host and one update budget cannot establish exact equivalence or close the broader state-retention/reconstruction agenda.
evidence_against.why: 本次小差异只限制本次掩码主张，不能作为关闭整条研究路线的依据。

uncertainty: 交接状态来源对象的技术修复成本尚未确定。
新建多步恢复家族仍需相应方向层决策；本提议不重开任何旧 C 家族。

cost.compute: 本次正式运行约四十秒，开发小样本约两秒；下一对象成本仍需自己的测量。
cost.owner_time: 可异步回应，当前完成结果与其它路线继续推进。

packet.verdict_text: The next useful N3 discriminator is state-source value at an actual handover, separating RETAIN, COPY and SHADOW rather than another mask repeat; resolve the already-registered DISH B01 technical dependency before scientific use.
